item.title: 017 Production Discipline: From Cognitive Completion to Product Autonomy
item.description: The concluding article of the Power Recalibration trilogy (014 → 016 → 017). It presents Product Autonomy as the final stage of intellectual production, where a completed work becomes capable of existing independently of its author through semantic and engineering quality assurance.
